harness_history: A subsequent focused run reached G01-G09 but ended before its final cleanup/exit evidence; it is not PASS. Only its known local fixture prefix was cleaned. The next run failed when PostgreSQL entered recovery: Windows Event 1000 points to libcrypto-3-x64.dll 3.5.7.0, exception 0xc0000005. No product assertion was weakened. Local PostgreSQL was restarted with process-scoped OPENSSL_ia32cap=:0 (documented OpenSSL compatibility override); final G ran unchanged. This is an environment mitigation, not a proven root-cause diagnosis or production configuration change.

On 2026-10-05 a fresh remote preflight read failed in Supabase CLI before a complete baseline or any write. The identical read succeeded independently; a new full preflight was taken. Earlier evidence remains separate.

During parallel hardening reruns, local PostgreSQL logged native exception 0xC0000005 and restarted. Python separately printed 694 OK but exited 3221225477; neither interrupted run is counted as PASS. Root restored all 49 tables exactly in each inherited database from saved baselines and removed only the focused fixture scope. Final gates rerun sequentially; cause remains unknown.

Fresh remote preflight stopped before any write when inherited authenticated TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER were observed on stats. Forward 038 was hardened before apply, with a local hosted-default privilege simulation and all affected SQL families rerun.
One parallel closure2 preparation hit a shared ALTER ROLE catalog conflict before fixtures. That family preparation was rerun sequentially as closure2r. No product mutation failure.

Four-build hardening runner recorded exit_code=0 for every subprocess and final PASS; PowerShell redirection surfaced PostgreSQL notices as outer status 1. Internal structured completion and dumps are authoritative.

Initial unfinished G harness missed initial_division_snapshots cleanup dependency. Targeted local fixture cleanup corrected it; prefix absence checked. Initial all-table restoration was not independently retained.
Later G09 synthetic finished/archived fixture omitted required timestamp and failed 23514 after G01-G08; finally exact 49-table comparison passed. Fixture timestamps corrected; product SQL unchanged.
A resumed run encountered stopped local PostgreSQL before DB interaction. Cluster restarted; full final G gate passed with exact cleanup.
